meta.title: Repo wiki
meta.description: Indexes a repository into a Git-shareable symbol-level knowledge base (.dsh-repowiki) that any session can query without re-reading source. repowiki-index builds a deterministic symbol index (no model calls); repowiki-extract and repowiki-generate spawn subagents inheriting the session model to write cards and wiki pages; repowiki-cards searches symbols and documents across sessions with locale-aware asset fallback; repowiki-context builds a character-bounded task evidence pack with line-numbered source, static relations, knowledge hits, symbol anchors and a labelled repo-map fallback; repowiki-impact analyzes file- or symbol-scoped change impact with lexical usage sites, affected-test routing, cycles, affected docs and risk; repowiki-status reports health, documentation coverage, wiki citation integrity (missing paths and #Lx-Ly bounds), a conservative unused-export audit, module coupling/instability and PageRank core files; repowiki-edit, -export, -import and -memory cover hand edits, snapshots and reviewed session memory. Assets travel with Git. Tools: repowiki-index, repowiki-cards, repowiki-context, repowiki-extract, repowiki-generate, repowiki-impact, repowiki-edit, repowiki-export, repowiki-import, repowiki-memory, repowiki-status.
